note: reach_unique_month is the platform's unique accounts for the month from an undated query; daily reach figures are never summed. profile_views is the platform's 'account-wide content views (reels, posts, stories)', not profile-page visits. Engagement components are per-media counts on the day a post was published; days without a post are NULL, not zero. impressions and follower counts are not available from this source for a closed month.
